findings.title: Negated Availing

findings.reader_payoff: The failure is theological sufficiency, not tactical usefulness or material wealth.
findings.containment: This denies independent protection; it does not deny that the brothers entered or that the precaution had a human purpose.

findings.title: Protected Parties

branch_activations.carrier: The knowledge noun carries knowing and grasping truth.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The teaching verb and final negated knowing verb repeat the knowledge field in distinct roles.
branch_activations.activation: Possessed knowledge contacts its taught source and its public contrast.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Jacob's knowledge is presented as a distinct, received mode of understanding.
branch_activations.boundary: Knowledge is not recast as control over divine outcomes.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ayırt edici ve yol gösterici işaret
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The knowledge field carries a distinguishing mark or orienting sign.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The obscure where and commanded route supply a separate need for orientation.
branch_activations.activation: Knowledge contacts the route problem as guidance that identifies a workable direction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Taught knowledge can orient action without guaranteeing its outcome.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed sign reading is an orienting function, not a replacement for the ordinary knowledge claim.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ihtiyacı karşılayıp yarar sağlama ve yerini tutma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir unsur, başka bir kişi veya durum için yeterli olur ve ihtiyacı karşılar.
branch_activations.carrier: The availing form carries sufficiency and benefit.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Negation and the divine-side relation deny sufficiency before God.
branch_activations.activation: The sufficiency branch contacts the knowledge claim as the boundary knowledge cannot cross.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Knowing how to act is distinguished from making the result secure.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not deny the ordinary usefulness of knowledge for action.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: çokluk ve sayıca artma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çokluk, azlığın karşıtıdır ve özellikle sayılabilen varlıklarda sayının yüksekliğini ya da artışını bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The elative carries numerical predominance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The people noun and negated knowledge predicate define what the majority does not know.
branch_activations.activation: Numerical predominance contacts the epistemic contrast as a warning against mass authority.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Most people can miss the distinction between guidance and mastery.
branch_activations.boundary: Numerical majority is not treated as proof that every member has the same state.

findings.title: Attributed Inward Completion
findings.claim: The outward act completes and may release an inward pressure while external causal limitation remains in force.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins need, inner intention or relief, and completion; the object of completion remains the inward need rather than the external danger.
findings.reader_payoff: Interior success and exterior limitation can coexist in the same act.
findings.containment: The relief facet is qualified and attributed; no psychological certainty or external protection is added.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus anchor and coordinates agree, but the HFT identity is legacy_unbound and the relief facet remains attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir şeye zorunlu olarak gereksinim duyma veya ondan yoksun olma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel durum, bir şey olmadan yapamama ve ona gereksinim duymadır.
branch_activations.carrier: The need form carries dependence and inward pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The self phrase supplies the interior location of the need.
branch_activations.activation: Need contacts self-location as the pressure seeking enactment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The act can meet a bounded inward need.
branch_activations.boundary: Need is not expanded into external danger removal.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: tamamlayıp bitirmek veya sona erip tükenmek
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işi veya süreci gereken son sınıra ulaştırarak tamamlayıp bitirme.
branch_activations.carrier: The completion verb carries closure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding need supplies the bounded object of completion.
branch_activations.activation: Completion contacts the need and closes it without changing external causality.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The inner concern is fulfilled rather than the brothers' safety guaranteed.
branch_activations.boundary: Completion does not entail removal of every outside threat.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sıkıntıyı hafifletip ferahlatma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Sıkıntı içindeki kişinin yükünü hafifletip onu rahatlatma eylemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The self field carries the possibility of relief from constriction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Completion supplies the act that can have an affective consequence.
branch_activations.activation: Relief contacts the completed need as a possible inward result.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The act may release an inward pressure.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace says may release; it does not assert a guaranteed psychological outcome.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: iç düşünce, niyet ve ayırt etme gücü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The self field carries an inward intention or deliberation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The need and command supply the motive and its enacted form.
branch_activations.activation: Inner intention contacts the need as the motive given outward form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The outward act can realize an inward purpose without mastering the result.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed intention is not treated as the only possible motive.

findings.title: Attributed Marked Route
findings.claim: The prescribed where can function as a practical knowledge-mark for movement through an obscure field, valuable as orientation rather than an outcome guarantee.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins indeterminate place, command-as-mark, taught knowledge, and completed entry, turning the route into performed orientation.
findings.reader_payoff: Knowledge helps action find a direction without promising what the movement will produce.
findings.containment: This route image is exploratory and attributed; it does not replace the concrete locative reading or claim a hidden map.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates agree, but the HFT source is legacy_unbound and labels the route synthesis exploratory.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: belirti veya belirlenmiş vakit
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir şeyi tanıtan veya gösteren belirti ve işarettir.
branch_activations.carrier: The command form carries a possible sign or marker function.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The unspecified locative supplies a field needing orientation.
branch_activations.activation: The command contacts the obscure where as a marker for route selection.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The prescribed command can orient movement through uncertainty.
branch_activations.boundary: The sign image does not guarantee the movement's outcome.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ardından gelen yan tümceyle belirlenen yer
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dil birimi, herhangi bir yeri başlangıçta belirli bir yer seçmeden gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: The locative carries an initially indeterminate place.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The command clause supplies the relation that orients that place.
branch_activations.activation: Indeterminate place contacts the command as the route's specifying instruction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: An obscure field becomes traversable through orientation.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not supply a place beyond the focus wording.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: içeri girmek veya içeri sokmak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da şey dışarıdaki bir konum veya durumdan içerideki konum veya duruma geçer.

findings.reader_payoff: An inward purpose can be pictured as a route that reaches action but not mastery.
